create_from_numpy: create a ggml tensor from a numpy array using the from_numpy function with a ggml context
create_to_numpy: convert a ggml tensor pointer back to a numpy array using the to_numpy function
build_and_compute: build a forward computation graph from a ggml tensor and execute it with build_and_compute
run_forward_pass: run a model forward pass by calling forward with a layer name, model pointer, and input tensors
load_fairseq2_model: load a fairseq2 GGML model file from disk using load_fairseq2_ggml_file with a model path
